:::{#exm-descent-direction}
#### How short is short enough

In @exm-gradient-descent, $f(x) = x^2$ at $x \ne 0$ has $g = 2x$, and
$f(x - 2 s x) = (1 - 2s)^2 x^2 < x^2$ exactly when $\abs{1 - 2s} < 1$, that is, when $0 < s < 1$.
So @thm-descent-direction holds with $\bar{s} = 1$,
and the step $s = 1.5$ of that example was too long.

@fig-descent-direction plots the [ratio](algebra-sums.qmd#def-ratio) $f(x - 2 s x) / f(x)$ against $s$.

{{< include mds/_subfiles/vector-calc/_fig-descent-direction.qmd >}}

:::
